            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2
        with:
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
      - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew
          key: ffmpeg-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/e2e.yml') }}
          restore-keys: ffmpeg-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: FFmpeg
        run: brew list ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install ffmpeg
      - name: Build release engine
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p isocast-daemon
      - name: Soak (program, two ISOs and a local RTMP stream)
        # The script stops recording 20 minutes before --deadline to verify
        # the last take and write its report; the deadline leaves 15 minutes
        # of the job for the summary and upload.
        run: |
          python3 scripts/soak.py --hours "$HOURS" \
            --deadline "$((SOAK_JOB_START + 335 * 60))" \
            --work "$RUNNER_TEMP/soak" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/soak-out"
      - name: Job summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/soak-out/report.json" ]; then
            python3 scripts/soak.py --summary "$RUNNER_TEMP/soak-out/report.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo '## Nightly soak: no report (build failed or the job was cancelled); see the logs.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Report and logs (no recordings)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: nightly-soak
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/soak-out
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Clean up scratch
        if: always()
        run: rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP:?}/soak" "${RUNNER_TEMP:?}/soak-out"

name: PR checks

# Checks the pull request's description against CONTRIBUTING.md: a change to
# the app's interface needs screenshots, and "How it was verified" can't be
# empty. Runs on `pull_request` (not pull_request_target) with a read-only
# token, so it is safe for forks: it runs the check script from the base
# branch, reads the description from the event, and changes nothing. Editing
# the description re-runs it.
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: pr-checks-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  description:
    name: description has the evidence
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out the base branch's check script
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Changed files
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          gh api --paginate "repos/$REPO/pulls/$NUMBER/files" --jq '.[].filename' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/files.txt"
          wc -l < "$RUNNER_TEMP/files.txt"

      - name: Description
        env:
          BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
        run: printf '%s' "$BODY" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/body.md"

      - name: Check
        run: python3 .github/scripts/pr_checks.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/body.md" "$RUNNER_TEMP/files.txt"

name: Visual

# Builds the pull request and its merge base, draws the app's standard views
# offscreen with both (scripts/visual-shots.sh: synthetic sources, its own
# clock, bundled fonts, no live readouts) and uploads before/after/diff PNGs
# with a manifest. It runs the pull request's code, so it gets a read-only
# token and no secrets; visual-report.yml (workflow_run, trusted) reads the
# artifact, posts the comment, runs the judge and sets the commit status.
#
# It starts on every pull request, but only builds when one of UI_PATHS
# changed; otherwise it uploads an empty manifest. (A `paths:` filter would
# leave other pull requests without the isocast/visual-check status, which
# blocks them forever once the check is required.)
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      base:
        description: Branch, tag or commit to compare against
        default: main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: visual-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  ISOCAST_SHOTS_WORK: /tmp/isocast-visual-shots
  # What the app shows depends on these; a change anywhere else skips the build.
  UI_PATHS: >-
    crates/isocast-ui/ crates/isocast-ui-interface/ crates/isocast-app/ui/ crates/isocast-protocol/
    scripts/visual-shots.sh scripts/visual_diff.py scripts/screenshots/offscreen.toml
    .github/workflows/visual.yml

jobs:
  changes:
    name: interface changed?
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      ui: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.ui }}
      head: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.head }}
      base: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.base }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Base and head
        id: refs
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          BASE_INPUT: ${{ inputs.base }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$BASE_SHA" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "${BASE_INPUT:-main}"
            BASE_SHA="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
          fi
          MERGE_BASE="$(git merge-base "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")"
          ui=false
          # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # UI_PATHS is a list of pathspecs
          if [ "$EVENT" = workflow_dispatch ] || [ -n "$(git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE" "$HEAD_SHA" -- $UI_PATHS)" ]; then
            ui=true
          fi
          {
            echo "head=$HEAD_SHA"
            echo "base=$MERGE_BASE"
            echo "ui=$ui"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "head $HEAD_SHA, merge base $MERGE_BASE, interface changed: $ui"

      - name: Empty manifest
        if: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.ui == 'false' }}
        env:
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.head }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.base }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/visual"
          jq -n --argjson pr "${PR:-0}" --arg head "$HEAD_SHA" --arg base "$BASE_SHA" \
            '{version: 1, pr: $pr, head_sha: $head, base_sha: $base, views: [], broken: [], gpu: [],
              note: "no interface files changed"}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/visual/manifest.json"

      - name: Upload
        if: ${{ steps.refs.outputs.ui == 'false' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: visual-screenshots
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/visual/
          retention-days: 14

  shots:
    name: screenshots (base vs head)
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.ui == 'true' }}
    # GitHub-hosted only: never run pull request code on our own machines.
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.head }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: GPU
        run: |
          sw_vers
          sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string
          system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType

      - name: Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
          rustc --version

      - name: Cargo cache
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2
        with:
          shared-key: visual-release
          # Only main writes the cache (run this workflow by hand on main to
          # warm it); pull requests read it.
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

      # The head's render and diff scripts draw both sides, so both use the
      # same views, sizes and setup.
      - name: Keep the head's scripts
        run: |
          tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools"
          mkdir -p "$tools/screenshots"
          cp scripts/visual-shots.sh scripts/visual_diff.py "$tools/"
          cp scripts/screenshots/offscreen.toml scripts/screenshots/landscape.jpg \
            scripts/screenshots/brb.jpg "$tools/screenshots/"

      # One checkout and one target folder, so the second build only
      # rebuilds what differs.
      - name: Build base
        env:
          SHA: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.base }}
        run: |
          git checkout --quiet --detach "$SHA"
          cargo build --release --locked -p isocast-ui -p isocast-daemon -p isocast-cli
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin-base"
          cp target/release/isocast target/release/isocastd target/release/isocast-ui "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin-base/"

      - name: Build head
        env:
          SHA: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.head }}
        run: |
          git checkout --quiet --detach "$SHA"
          cargo build --release --locked -p isocast-ui -p isocast-daemon -p isocast-cli
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin-head"
          cp target/release/isocast target/release/isocastd target/release/isocast-ui "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin-head/"

      # visual-shots.sh fails if the GPU adapter is a software one, and
      # visual_diff.py if a picture is blank: comparing those would be noise.
      - name: Render
        # One view at a time, as before the local default of 4: the
        # runner's few cores are shared with the engine.
        env:
          JOBS: "1"
        run: |
          tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools"
          "$tools/visual-shots.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin-base" "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots-base"
          "$tools/visual-shots.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin-head" "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots-head"

      - name: Compare
        id: compare
        env:
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.head }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.base }}
        run: |
          set +e
          python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/visual_diff.py" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots-base" "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots-head" "$RUNNER_TEMP/visual" \
            ${PR:+--pr "$PR"} --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
            --gpu "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots-base/gpu.txt" --gpu "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots-head/gpu.txt"
          echo "rc=$?" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.compare.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: visual-screenshots
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/visual/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Logs
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: tail -n 20 "$RUNNER_TEMP"/shots-*/logs/*.log || true

      - name: Broken renders fail the job
        if: ${{ steps.compare.outputs.rc != '0' }}
        run: |
          echo "visual_diff.py found blank or broken pictures (see Compare); the GPU may not be drawing in this runner."
          exit 1

name: Visual report

# The trusted half of the visual check. It runs on the base repository's
# default branch after "Visual" finishes, never checks out or runs pull
# request code, and only reads the screenshot artifact (validated: known
# names, PNG and JSON only, size caps) and the GitHub API. It pushes the
# images to the orphan branch `ci-screenshots` under pr/<number>/<head sha>/,
# runs the judge (a restricted OpenCode agent, .github/visual-judge, only
# with the OPENCODE_API_KEY secret), upserts one comment and sets the commit
# status `isocast/visual-check` on the head commit.
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Visual]
    types: [completed]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  render-status:
    name: report lane render result
    # Default-branch code; use GitHub's job conclusion, never PR code or artifacts.
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.path == '.github/workflows/visual.yml' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.id == github.event.repository.id &&
      startsWith(github.event.workflow_run.head_branch, 'ci/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      statuses: write
    steps:
      - name: Report whether screenshots rendered and compared (not a judge verdict)
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.html_url }}
          CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          shots=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/attempts/$ATTEMPT/jobs" \
            --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name == "screenshots (base vs head)") | .conclusion')
          case "$shots:$CONCLUSION" in
            skipped:success) exit 0 ;; # no UI paths changed
            success:success) state=success; description='Screenshots rendered and compared; no broken renders' ;;
            failure:*) state=failure; description='Screenshot build, render or comparison failed' ;;
            *) state=error; description='No completed screenshot comparison' ;;
          esac
          gh api "repos/$REPO/statuses/$HEAD_SHA" -f context=isocast/visual-render \
            -f state="$state" -f description="$description" -f target_url="$RUN_URL" >/dev/null

  report:
    name: comment, judge and status
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' }}
    # Only image publishers need serialising. Approval must not block render-status.
    concurrency:
      group: visual-report
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    # OPENCODE_API_KEY lives in this environment, which only main may use,
    # so a workflow pushed on any other branch can't read it.
    environment: visual-judge
    permissions:
      actions: read # the other run's artifact
      contents: write # the ci-screenshots branch
      pull-requests: write # the comment and labels
      statuses: write # isocast/visual-check
    env:
      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      RUN_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.html_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Work folder
        run: echo "WORK=$RUNNER_TEMP/visual" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Check out the trusted scripts (default branch)
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download the screenshots
        id: download
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: visual-screenshots
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/visual/artifact
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Validate the artifact
        id: artifact
        if: ${{ steps.download.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          EVENT_PR: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/visual_report.py validate "$WORK/artifact"
          manifest="$WORK/artifact/manifest.json"
          pr="$(jq -r '.pr' "$manifest")"
          sha="$(jq -r '.head_sha' "$manifest")"
          if [ "$sha" != "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "the artifact is for $sha, not this run's $HEAD_SHA"; exit 1
          fi
          # Same-repository runs name the PR in the event; fork runs don't, so
          # the artifact's number is used and checked against the API below.
          if [ -n "$EVENT_PR" ] && [ "$EVENT_PR" != "$pr" ]; then
            echo "the artifact says PR $pr, the event says $EVENT_PR"; exit 1
          fi
          echo "pr=$pr" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check the pull request and fetch its interface diff
        id: pr
        if: ${{ steps.artifact.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ steps.artifact.outputs.pr }}
        run: |
          set +e
          python3 scripts/visual_report.py pr --repo "$REPO" --pr "$PR" --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
            --diff "$WORK/ui.diff" --sources "$WORK/sources"
          rc=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$rc" = 3 ]; then echo "current=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0; fi
          [ "$rc" = 0 ]
          echo "current=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Pending status
        if: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.current == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPO/statuses/$HEAD_SHA" -f state=pending -f context=isocast/visual-check \
            -f description="Judging the screenshots" -f target_url="$RUN_URL" > /dev/null

      - name: Push the images to ci-screenshots
        id: images
        if: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.current == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ steps.artifact.outputs.pr }}
        run: |
          auth="AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | base64 -w0)"
          pages="$WORK/pages"
          git init --quiet "$pages"
          cd "$pages"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git remote add origin "https://github.com/$REPO.git"
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if git -c http.extraheader="$auth" fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin ci-screenshots 2>/dev/null; then
              git checkout --quiet -B ci-screenshots FETCH_HEAD
            else
              git checkout --quiet --orphan ci-screenshots
              git rm -rf --quiet . 2>/dev/null || true
              printf 'Screenshots for pull requests, written by .github/workflows/visual-report.yml.\n' > README.md
              git add README.md
            fi
            dest="pr/$PR/$HEAD_SHA"
            rm -rf "${dest:?}"
            mkdir -p "$dest"
            cp -R "$WORK/artifact/." "$dest/"
            git add -A
            git commit --quiet -m "PR #$PR at $HEAD_SHA" || true
            if git -c http.extraheader="$auth" push --quiet origin HEAD:ci-screenshots; then
              echo "commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Judge
        id: judge
        if: ${{ steps.images.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          VISION_MODEL: ${{ vars.VISION_MODEL }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$OPENCODE_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "skipped=the OPENCODE_API_KEY secret is not set" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! jq -e '[.views[] | select(.status != "unchanged")] | length > 0' "$WORK/artifact/manifest.json" > /dev/null; then
            echo "skipped=nothing changed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          npm install --global --no-fund --no-audit @opencode/cli@2.0.28
          python3 scripts/visual_judge.py "$WORK/artifact" --judge .github/visual-judge \
            --work "$WORK/judge" --out "$WORK/judge.json" --diff "$WORK/ui.diff" \
            --sources "$WORK/sources" --max-views 15 --timeout 150

      - name: Comment
        id: comment
        if: ${{ steps.images.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ steps.artifact.outputs.pr }}
          IMAGES: ${{ steps.images.outputs.commit }}
          SKIPPED: ${{ steps.judge.outputs.skipped }}
          JUDGE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.judge.outcome }}
        run: |
          judge=""
          [ -f "$WORK/judge.json" ] && judge="$WORK/judge.json"
          skipped="${SKIPPED:-}"
          [ "$JUDGE_OUTCOME" = failure ] && skipped="the judge step failed"
          python3 scripts/visual_report.py comment "$WORK/artifact" --repo "$REPO" --pr "$PR" \
            --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" --images-commit "$IMAGES" --run-url "$RUN_URL" \
            ${judge:+--judge "$judge"} ${skipped:+--judge-skipped "$skipped"} \
            --markdown "$WORK/comment.md" --status "$WORK/status.json"
          id="$(gh api --paginate "repos/$REPO/issues/$PR/comments" \
            --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | startswith("<!-- isocast-visual -->"))) | .id' | head -n 1)"
          if [ -n "$id" ]; then
            url="$(gh api -X PATCH "repos/$REPO/issues/comments/$id" -F body=@"$WORK/comment.md" --jq .html_url)"
          else
            url="$(gh api "repos/$REPO/issues/$PR/comments" -F body=@"$WORK/comment.md" --jq .html_url)"
          fi
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Labels
        if: ${{ steps.comment.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ steps.artifact.outputs.pr }}
        run: |
          changed="$(jq '[.views[] | select(.status != "unchanged")] | length' "$WORK/artifact/manifest.json")"
          state="$(jq -r .state "$WORK/status.json")"
          label() { # label add|remove NAME
            if [ "$1" = add ]; then
              gh api "repos/$REPO/issues/$PR/labels" -f "labels[]=$2" > /dev/null
            else
              gh api -X DELETE "repos/$REPO/issues/$PR/labels/$(jq -rn --arg l "$2" '$l|@uri')" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
            fi
          }
          if [ "$changed" -gt 0 ]; then label add visual-change; else label remove visual-change; fi
          if [ "$state" = failure ]; then label add 'visual-regression?'; else label remove 'visual-regression?'; fi

      - name: Status
        if: ${{ steps.comment.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          URL: ${{ steps.comment.outputs.url }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPO/statuses/$HEAD_SHA" -f context=isocast/visual-check \
            -f state="$(jq -r .state "$WORK/status.json")" \
            -f description="$(jq -r .description "$WORK/status.json")" \
            -f target_url="$URL" > /dev/null

      # The render failed, the artifact was rejected or a step above broke:
      # say so on the commit instead of leaving no status (or a pending one).
      - name: Error status
        if: ${{ always() && steps.pr.outputs.current != 'false' && (failure() || steps.download.outcome != 'success' || steps.comment.outcome != 'success') }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPO/statuses/$HEAD_SHA" -f context=isocast/visual-check -f state=error \
            -f description="The visual check couldn't run (screenshots: $CONCLUSION)" \
            -f target_url="$RUN_URL" > /dev/null

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Existing version tag (X.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z); must match Cargo.toml'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

# Serialize tag pushes and manual reruns together; never interrupt signing.
concurrency:
  group: isocast-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Decide before the approval gate and without secrets: a missing tag or a
  # version mismatch fails here, and an already published version ends the
  # run green with nothing to do instead of asking for an approval.
  preflight:
    if: github.repository == 'anomalyco/isocast' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
      commit: ${{ steps.version.outputs.commit }}
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      proceed: ${{ steps.version.outputs.proceed }}
    steps:
      - name: Validate the version, its tag and its release state
        id: version
        env:
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tomllib
          value = os.environ['REF_NAME'] if os.environ['EVENT'] == 'push' else os.environ['INPUT_VERSION']
          if not re.fullmatch(r'v?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+', value):
              sys.exit('version must be X.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z')
          version = value.removeprefix('v')
          tag = f'v{version}'
          repo = os.environ['REPO']
          def api(path):
              result = subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', f'repos/{repo}/{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
              if result.returncode == 0:
                  return 200, json.loads(result.stdout)
              try:
                  status = int(json.loads(result.stdout)['status'])
              except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                  sys.exit(f'GitHub API call failed for {path}: {result.stderr.strip()}')
              return status, None
          status, _ = api(f'git/ref/tags/{tag}')
          if status == 404:
              sys.exit(f'{tag} does not exist in {repo}; push the tag from the public snapshot checkout first')
          if status != 200:
              sys.exit(f'could not resolve {tag} (HTTP {status})')
          status, commit = api(f'commits/refs/tags/{tag}')
          if status != 200 or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', commit['sha']):
              sys.exit(f'could not resolve the commit at {tag}')
          status, cargo = api(f'contents/Cargo.toml?ref=refs/tags/{tag}')
          if status != 200:
              sys.exit(f'could not read Cargo.toml at {tag} (HTTP {status})')
          try:
              crate = tomllib.loads(base64.b64decode(cargo['content']).decode())['workspace']['package']['version']
          except (tomllib.TOMLDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
              sys.exit(f'Cargo.toml at {tag} has no [workspace.package] version')
          if crate != version:
              sys.exit(f'{tag} does not match workspace.package.version {crate} at that tag')
          # This endpoint lists published releases only; drafts stay the
          # finalizer's business, which reuses a matching draft.
          status, release = api(f'releases/tags/{tag}')
          if status not in (200, 404):
              sys.exit(f'could not read the release state of {tag} (HTTP {status})')
          proceed = status == 404
          # The release notes (#106): docs/releases/X.Y.Z.md at the tag is
          # what the update window and the GitHub release show. Same rules
          # as release_notes() in scripts/release-finalize.py.
          if proceed:
              notes_path = f'docs/releases/{version}.md'
              status, notes = api(f'contents/{notes_path}?ref=refs/tags/{tag}')
              if status == 404:
                  sys.exit(f'{notes_path} is missing at {tag}: write the release notes, commit them and tag again (docs/releasing.md, "Cut a release")')
              if status != 200:
                  sys.exit(f'could not read {notes_path} at {tag} (HTTP {status})')
              try:
                  text = base64.b64decode(notes['content']).decode().strip()
              except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
                  sys.exit(f'{notes_path} at {tag} is not a UTF-8 file')
              if not text:
                  sys.exit(f'{notes_path} is empty at {tag}: write the release notes before tagging')
              if '**Full Changelog**' in text:
                  sys.exit(f'{notes_path}: leave out the **Full Changelog** line; the GitHub release adds it')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as out:
              out.write(f'commit={commit["sha"]}\n')
              out.write(f'tag={tag}\nversion={version}\nproceed={str(proceed).lower()}\n')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'], 'a') as out:
              if proceed:
                  out.write(f'## {tag}\n\nNot published yet; the release job builds it after approval.\n')
              else:
                  out.write(f'## {tag}\n\nAlready published: {release["html_url"]}\n\nNothing to build or draft; a published release is never changed.\n')
          if not proceed:
              print(f'::notice::{tag} is already published; nothing to build or draft')
          PY

  linux-packages:
    needs: preflight
    if: needs.preflight.outputs.proceed == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/windows.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    with:
      linux_release_commit: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.commit }}

  release:
    needs: preflight
    if: needs.preflight.outputs.proceed == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 90
    # Configure Ryan as required reviewer BEFORE adding environment secrets.
    environment: release
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/target
      # Icon Composer needs Xcode 26 on a macOS 26 host: on the macos-15 image
      # actool's AssetCatalogAgent crashed compiling Isocast.icon (0.0.3 run).
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_26.3.app/Contents/Developer
      TAG: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.tag }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Scratch locations
        run: printf 'ISOCAST_SCRATCH=%s\nRELEASE_OUTPUT=%s/isocast-release\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.tag }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Installer DMG tool (pinned dmgbuild)
        run: python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-deps --require-hashes -r scripts/dmg/requirements.txt
      - name: Check release source, architecture and release state
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          test "$(uname -m)" = arm64
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse "$TAG^{commit}")"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ needs.preflight.outputs.commit }}"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, tomllib
          with open('Cargo.toml', 'rb') as file:
              version = tomllib.load(file)['workspace']['package']['version']
          if version != os.environ['VERSION']:
              raise SystemExit('tag/input version does not match workspace.package.version')
          PY
          # Published since preflight (for example while waiting for approval):
          # stop before any secret is decoded. Only a 404 (no published
          # release) continues; an API failure is not "unpublished".
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess, sys
          tag, repo = os.environ['TAG'], os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']
          result = subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', f'repos/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
          if result.returncode == 0:
              sys.exit(f'{tag} is already published ({json.loads(result.stdout).get("html_url", "")}); a published release is never changed')
          try:
              status = int(json.loads(result.stdout)['status'])
          except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
              sys.exit(f'could not read the release state of {tag}: {result.stderr.strip()}')
          if status != 404:
              sys.exit(f'could not read the release state of {tag} (HTTP {status})')
          PY
          python3 scripts/release-finalize.py --check-notes "$VERSION"
          xcrun --find actool
          xcrun --find notarytool
          # The app's Sparkle public key must be the real one (not the placeholder).
          scripts/sparkle/sparkle.sh public-key >/dev/null
      # The virtual camera extension (#67) ships only with its two Developer ID
      # provisioning profiles; fail here, before the long build, while they're
      # missing. release.sh checks them again against the signing certificate.
      - name: Virtual camera provisioning profiles
        env:
          ENGINE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64: ${{ secrets.ENGINE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64 }}
          CAMERA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64: ${{ secrets.CAMERA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64 }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, binascii, os, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          os.umask(0o077)
          root = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'isocast-release-signing'
          root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          paths = {}
          for secret, name in [('ENGINE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64', 'isocast-engine.provisionprofile'),
                               ('CAMERA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64', 'isocast-camera.provisionprofile')]:
              try:
                  data = base64.b64decode(os.environ.get(secret, '').strip(), validate=True)
              except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
                  data = b''
              if not data:
                  sys.exit(f'{secret} is missing or not base64: add the Developer ID provisioning profile (docs/releasing.md, step 4a)')
              (root / name).write_bytes(data)
              paths[secret] = root / name
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as out:
              out.write(f"ISOCAST_ENGINE_PROFILE={paths['ENGINE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64']}\n")
              out.write(f"ISOCAST_CAMERA_PROFILE={paths['CAMERA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_B64']}\n")
          PY
          python3 scripts/vcam-package.py release-profiles "$RUNNER_TEMP/isocast-release-signing/isocast-engine.provisionprofile" "$RUNNER_TEMP/isocast-release-signing/isocast-camera.provisionprofile"
      - name: Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
          rustc --version
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2
        with:
          shared-key: release-arm64
      - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew
          key: release-brew-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/release.yml') }}
          restore-keys: release-brew-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: Runtime verification tools
        run: brew list ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install ffmpeg
      - name: Import signing identity and notarization key
        env:
          DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64 }}
          DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_P8_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_P8_BASE64 }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, json, os, re, secrets, shlex, subprocess, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          os.umask(0o077)
          root = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'isocast-release-signing'
          root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          team = os.environ['APPLE_TEAM_ID']
          if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z0-9]{10}', team):
              sys.exit('APPLE_TEAM_ID must be a 10-character team id')
          def run(label, *args):
              try:
                  result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
              except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                  sys.exit(f'{label} timed out; signing data is not logged')
              if result.returncode:
                  sys.exit(f'{label} failed (exit {result.returncode}); signing data is not logged')
              return result.stdout
          original = shlex.split(run('keychain inventory', 'security', 'list-keychains', '-d', 'user'))
          (root / 'search-list.json').write_text(json.dumps(original))
          for name, secret in [('certificate.p12', 'DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64'), ('AuthKey.p8', 'APPLE_API_KEY_P8_BASE64')]:
              try:
                  data = base64.b64decode(os.environ[secret], validate=True)
                  if not data: raise ValueError()
              except ValueError:
                  sys.exit(f'{secret} must be nonempty single-line base64')
              (root / name).write_bytes(data)
          password = [REDACTED]
          print(f'::add-mask::{password}', flush=True)
          keychain = str(root / 'signing.keychain-db')
          run('keychain creation', 'security', 'create-keychain', '-p', password, keychain)
          run('keychain settings', 'security', 'set-keychain-settings', '-lut', '21600', keychain)
          run('keychain unlock', 'security', 'unlock-keychain', '-p', password, keychain)
          run('certificate import', 'security', 'import', str(root / 'certificate.p12'), '-P', os.environ['DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD'], '-t', 'cert', '-f', 'pkcs12', '-k', keychain, '-T', '/usr/bin/codesign', '-T', '/usr/bin/security')
          run('key access', 'security', 'set-key-partition-list', '-S', 'apple-tool:,apple:', '-s', '-k', password, keychain)
          run('keychain search list', 'security', 'list-keychains', '-d', 'user', '-s', keychain, *original)
          identities = re.findall(r'([0-9A-F]{40}) "(Developer ID Application: [^"\n]+)"', run('signing identity', 'security', 'find-identity', '-v', '-p', 'codesigning', keychain))
          identities = [fingerprint for fingerprint, name in identities if name.endswith(f'({team})')]
          if len(identities) != 1: sys.exit('expected exactly one Developer ID Application identity for APPLE_TEAM_ID')
          print(f'::add-mask::{identities[0]}', flush=True)
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as out:
              out.write(f'ISOCAST_SIGN_KEYCHAIN={keychain}\nISOCAST_SIGN_IDENTITY={identities[0]}\nAPPLE_API_KEY_PATH={root / "AuthKey.p8"}\n')
          (root / 'certificate.p12').unlink()
          PY
      - name: Check the Sparkle update signing key
        env:
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, binascii, os, sys
          try:
              key = base64.b64decode(os.environ.get('SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY', '').strip(), validate=True)
          except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
              key = b''
          # generate_keys -x: a 32-byte seed (current) or 96 bytes (older keys).
          if len(key) not in (32, 96):
              sys.exit('SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY is missing or not a Sparkle EdDSA private key (generate_keys -x); its value is not logged')
          print('Sparkle signing key present')
          PY
      - name: Build and Developer ID-sign native app and DMG
        run: scripts/release.sh --output "$RELEASE_OUTPUT"
      - name: Notarize, verify mounted runtime, create or refresh one draft
        timeout-minutes: 40
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          scripts/release.sh --notarize --verify-runtime --hosted \
            --draft-release --verify-tag --replace-draft \
            --output "$RELEASE_OUTPUT"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          draft = json.loads((Path(os.environ['RELEASE_OUTPUT']) / 'draft.json').read_text())
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'], 'a') as out:
              out.write(f'## Unpublished release draft\n\n{draft["url"]}\n')
          PY
      - name: Remove temporary signing material
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os, shutil, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'isocast-release-signing'
          if not root.exists(): raise SystemExit(0)
          errors = []
          try:
              saved = root / 'search-list.json'
              if saved.exists():
                  result = subprocess.run(['security', 'list-keychains', '-d', 'user', '-s', *json.loads(saved.read_text())], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
                  if result.returncode: errors.append('keychain search-list restore failed')
              keychain = root / 'signing.keychain-db'
              if keychain.exists():
                  result = subprocess.run(['security', 'delete-keychain', str(keychain)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
                  if result.returncode: errors.append('temporary keychain deletion failed')
          finally:
              shutil.rmtree(root)
          if errors: raise SystemExit('; '.join(errors))
          print('Temporary keychain, API key and certificate removed')
          PY

  attach-linux:
    needs: [preflight, release, linux-packages]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: release
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: 'isocast-{deb-*,linux-*}'
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/isocast-linux-packages
      - name: Attach Linux packages to the existing unpublished draft
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.version }}
          ISOCAST_LINUX_ARTIFACTS: ${{ runner.temp }}/isocast-linux-packages
        run: python3 scripts/release-finalize.py --attach-linux "$VERSION" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/staged"
